name: Force 120 FPS
description: Runs Geometry Dash at 120 FPS on PC, Mac and Android, even on 60 Hz screens.

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: Frame rate the game is forced to run at. Default is 120.

uncap-mobile.name: Run past screen refresh (Android)
uncap-mobile.description: Runs the game at the target FPS even if your screen refreshes slower (e.g. 120 FPS on a 60 Hz phone). The game updates and reads taps at the full rate; the screen shows the newest frame each refresh. Uses more battery and may warm the phone.

disable-vsync.name: Disable VSync (PC/Mac)
disable-vsync.description: VSync caps the game at your monitor's refresh rate. Turn it off so 120 FPS works even on a 60 Hz monitor.
